dedupe_keys.name: hm land registry price paid data england and wales

description: Price Paid Data from HM Land Registry lists residential property sales in England and Wales, downloadable in text or CSV format and as linked data. The GOV.UK page, first published in July 2014, is updated every month; the latest update on 28 August 2026 added July 2026 data, with yearly files and the complete dataset also available. Look-up tables link each Price Paid transaction identifier to Unique Property Reference Numbers (UPRN) and to INSPIRE IDs for registered freehold and leasehold property, each under its own licence conditions. Coverage: England and Wales. Access: monthly, yearly and full downloads and linked data. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 with a required attribution statement; free for commercial and non-commercial use, though the OGL does not cover third-party rights. Caveats: the data cover sales, not the whole stock. Simulation uses are property value exposure and post-flood price effects, and linking sales to buildings through UPRNs. Related records: the England and Wales energy performance certificates and OS Open Linked Identifiers, which also use UPRNs.
